s10.old: 4. **Regenerating live from WORKTREE code trips `dashboard_integrity` - correctly.** The fingerprint hashes `fec/make_member_desk.py` **as it exists in the live tree**, so running worktree code against live data means "declared inputs unchanged, output changed" -> `IntegrityError: same dashboard inputs produced a different semantic bundle`.
